subject: Service Day 2026 registration is now open
message: Browse the available NGO activities on the Service Day Dashboard and reserve your slot before the stated cut-off date. Each employee may join more than one activity, subject to slot availability.

subject: Last slots: Meal Pack Assembly Line
message: Only a few slots remain for the Food Bank Kuala Lumpur meal pack session on 13 December 2026. Register now if you intend to join.

subject: Reminder: Animal Shelter Care on 28 November
message: Your Service Day activity at Paws and Claws Shelter takes place on 28 November 2026 at 09:00. Please arrive fifteen minutes early for the safety briefing.
